title: Kanda 13: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 13.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 13.

verses.original: रोहितो द्यावापृथिवी जजान तत्र तन्तुं परमेष्ठी ततान ।
verses.transliteration: rohito dyāvāpṛthivī jajāna tatra tantuṁ parameṣṭhī tatāna |
verses.translation: Rohita, the golden rising sun, created heaven and earth; therein Parameshthin spread the luminous web of creation.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The solar creative power weaving the interconnected web of life and light.
